## s12-v13 — argument map

The world-born (bhavato 'ntaracāri bhāvajātaṃ) worshipped as chief (prabhuvanmukhyatayaiva pūjitaṃ) by being inside You. How, Lord (katham īśān), could non-being outside (bhavato bahir apy abhāvamātrā) be worshipped (samarcyate), or by whom (vā)? Inside worshipped, outside how: the puzzle of worship's ground.

### Open
- Whether 'bhavato 'ntaracāri' means 'dwelling inside You' or 'moving inside You' is unresolved.
- Whether 'abhāvamātrā' means 'mere non-being' or 'only non-being' is unresolved.
